text:
mo: hey all — opening my first PR, small feature that adds a runtime feature flag + a tiny integration test. quick Qs: branch naming, whether flags need an RFC or just a note, commit prefix for migrations, and who usually signs off on staged rollouts?
tara: welcome! branch: `feature/ENG-8021-add-ff-kv-cache` (kebab after ticket). no RFC for small flags but add a short rationale in the PR body and a feature-flag ticket if it affects behavior.
ben: feature flags that touch user-visible behavior should have a rollout plan in the PR and `needs-staging` label. For infra-only flags (internal toggles), just document how to flip them.
mo: commit msg prefix for DB migrations or schema changes?
tara: use `db:` or `migrate:` prefix, e.g. `migrate: add shard_index (ENG-8021)`. Put migration plan and rollback steps in the PR. If migration is destructive, coordinate with infra and tag `@infra-db`.
ben: tests: small integration tests that hit a local mock are fine. If it hits shared infra, use recorded fixtures and add flakiness notes in PR.
ci-bot: [CI] Build started for branch feature/ENG-8021-add-ff-kv-cache  lint queued, unit-tests queued
mo: do flags require a config file change or are they dynamic? also who toggles them in prod?
tara: depends: some flags are dynamic via our feature-store and can be toggled by SRE; others are compile-time and require deploy. Note which in PR. If SRE must toggle, add `ops: action-required` in the PR description.
ben: reviewers: check CODEOWNERS first. For runtime changes ping `@team-runtime` and add `@ben` for a quick look. Approval rule: 1 owner or 2 reviewers. Staged rollout signoff usually needs `@product` + `@sre` for infra-impacting flags.
mo: merge strategy? do we squash these tiny commits?
tara: squash-and-merge for minor fixes. For the feature flag change, keep one commit for logic and one for tests; tag them clearly. Avoid force-pushing to shared branches.
mo: labels we should add?
ben: add `area/runtime`, `type/feat`, estimate `size/s`. Add `needs-staging` if you want a preview deploy and `backport-needed` if this should land on older release branches.
mentor-on-call: tip: paste a mini-checklist in your PR body:
- Summary + why flag
- How to flip the flag (steps)
- Local test instructions (commands/env)
- CI status / known flakes
- Labels: area/*, type/*, size/*
mo: thanks! i'll open a Draft PR (WIP) and ping `@ben` for a quick pre-review before requesting formal reviewers. really appreciate it :rocket:
